_about: Attunements and keys per Codex instance (tools/lib/codex/attunements.js, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, 'Codex'). Each entry names only its goal (the quests that end the chain, or the key item) and our own one-line note; the steps are built from the Codex's quests (pre, preAny), items (sources) and npcs. `links` adds a prerequisite our quest data lacks, each with its public source. `inside` places an NPC or object of a chain that has no open-world spawn and that the Codex places in no instance (a quest giver, turn-in or objective inside a dungeon), with its public source. `removed` lists what Forever took out, with the evidence. Sources checked on 2026-10-15 against client build 1.60.1.70374.

attunements.name: Attunement to the Core
attunements.note: Lets Lothos Riftwaker in Blackrock Mountain send you to the Molten Core; without it, walk in through Blackrock Depths.

attunements.name: Aqual Quintessence
attunements.note: Douses the Molten Core's runes; Majordomo Executus comes out only when every rune is doused. Duke Hydraxis hands it out once Hands of the Enemy is done.
sources: https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Aqual_Quintessence (Source: once you complete Hands of the Enemy, Duke Hydraxis gives it)

attunements.name: Drakefire Amulet
attunements.note: Everyone entering Onyxia's Lair carries the Drakefire Amulet.

attunements.name: Drakefire Amulet
attunements.note: Everyone entering Onyxia's Lair carries the Drakefire Amulet.

attunements.name: Blackhand's Command
attunements.note: Lets you touch the Orb of Command in Upper Blackrock Spire to reach Blackwing Lair; without it, walk in through the spire.

attunements.name: The Dread Citadel
attunements.note: Everyone entering Naxxramas needs it; which of the three quests you take depends on your standing with the Argent Dawn.

attunements.name: Skeleton Key
attunements.note: Opens Scholomance's gate; one key opens it for the group.

attunements.name: Skeleton Key
attunements.note: Opens Scholomance's gate; one key opens it for the group.

attunements.name: Shadowforge Key
attunements.note: Opens the Shadowforge gates in Blackrock Depths; one key opens them for the group.

attunements.name: Prison Cell Key
attunements.note: Opens the cells of Blackrock Depths' prison.

attunements.name: Key to the City
attunements.note: Opens the Eastwall Gate into Stratholme's Scourge-held districts.

attunements.name: Crescent Key
attunements.note: Opens the inner doors of Dire Maul's North and West wings.

attunements.name: Workshop Key
attunements.note: Opens Gnomeregan's back door, the Workshop entrance.

attunements.name: The Scarlet Key
attunements.note: Opens the doors of the Armory and the Cathedral.

attunements.name: Dalaran Sewer Key
attunements.note: Opens the gate of the Horde's way into the City of Dalaran; one key opens it for the group. The Alliance walks in through the sewer pipe in Cantrips & Crows.

source.note: Unlocking the City of Dalaran: Prison Break In and Key to the City, then Dalaran Patrols, then Blood in the Streets
series: Blood in the Streets, Heart of Disruption, Shrewd Negotiations

sources.note: 'the Molten Core entry portal in Blackrock Depths'

removed.name: Seal of Ascension
removed.why: Forever's Seal of Ascension quest no longer rewards the seal, and the Forever client has no ItemSparse row for it, so Upper Blackrock Spire takes no key.

sources.note: Forever change: 'Rewards: no longer Seal of Ascension'
